analyst_view.overall: Early view: AZ go to Zwolle on Sunday afternoon, three days after a Europa League away game at Sparta Prague. PEC will be in their third match under Alex Pastoor, appointed on 7 November, and have only 13 goals in 12 games; AZ broke a poor run by coming back from 1-3 to beat Groningen 4-3.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals. AZ's recent games have been wild, but PEC rarely score and Pastoor's first job is to make them harder to beat, while AZ will have travelled back from Prague. Those pull in opposite directions, so I stay with the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners, 5.8 for AZ. AZ's wide players Ro-Zangelo Daal and Elijah Dijkstra create plenty of crossing positions even when the team is rotated, so I keep the figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. There is no rivalry here and no bans in the news; a PEC side defending deep may commit a few fouls, which the away-light split already reflects.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.8 shots, 17 of them AZ's. I lean lower: AZ will be on their third game in a week after a Thursday night in Prague, and Leeroy Echteld is likely to rotate, which usually takes the edge off their shot volume.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. With PEC's blunt attack (13 goals in 12) and a probably tired AZ, I expect a little less than the estimate.
